content: पाणिः [पण्-इण् आयाभावः, <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Uṇ. 4. 132</ls>] .²1 The hand; दानेन पाणिर्न तु कङ्कणेन (विभाति) <ls>Bh. 2. 71</ls>; often at the end of <ab>comp.</ab> in the sense of ‘carrying in the hand’; as चक्र˚, खड्ग˚ <ab>&c.</ab>; पाणिं ग्रह् or पीड् ‘to take the hand of, lead to the altar, marry’. पाणौ कृ to hold by the hand, marry; पाणौकरणम् ‘marriage’. .²2 <ab>Ved.</ab> A hoof. .{@-णिः@} {%f.%} A market.
